name: product-management
description: Gestion de produit : decouverte (hypotheses, opportunity solution tree, entretiens), strategie (vision, positionnement, modele economique, prix), marche (concurrence, personas, segments), execution (PRD, user stories, roadmap, pre-mortem, sprint, retro, notes de version), retro-specification d'un code existant (code-to-prd, schematic, intended-vs-implemented).
